**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (a.novak, gateway, 2026-03-14 02:12–02:14) shipped a config change flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That change exhausts the connection pool (20/20 in use) under normal load, so requests queue and time out with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, returned to clients as 503s.

**Impact window:** started 2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC, still ongoing as of the last log entry at 03:59:27 UTC. Wait queue has climbed steadily from 13 to 74 requests over that time, so it's not self-healing.

**Scope:** gateway only. Workers (`worker.log`) show no errors in this window — jobs finished normally the whole time.

**Action:** roll back `dep-4471` on the gateway. No other deploy in that window touches the pool.
